title: Fernhill Cloud inbox
description: Made-up inbound sales and support messages for Fernhill Cloud, a file sync company that does not exist. Every name, message and label here is synthetic.
context: Each row is one inbound message to the shared inbox of Fernhill Cloud, a made-up file sync and backup service.

columns.header: Team: billing = payment, invoice, charge or refund problems | tech = bugs, errors, sync failures and outages | sales = pricing, quotes, demos, upgrades, seats

suggestions: Topic: login | sync | pricing | invoice | security

rows.text: Hi, could you send me a copy of the invoice for March? Our accountant needs the receipt for the books.
I was charged twice for my Pro plan this month. This is the second time it has happened and it is getting annoying. Please reverse the extra charge.
You charged my card $480 after I cancelled. This is outrageous and frankly a rip off. Refund it immediately or I dispute it with my bank.
We would like to move from monthly to annual billing. How does the payment work, and will we get one invoice for the year?
Our payment failed this morning and the dashboard says the account will be suspended today. Can you retry the card right away? We cannot work without it.
I asked for a VAT invoice two weeks ago and still have nothing. Quite disappointing, and not good enough for a paid product.
Can I change the credit card on file? The old card expires next month. No rush.
THIS IS THE THIRD INVOICE WITH THE WRONG AMOUNT!!! Fix the billing right now, it is unacceptable.
Do you give refunds if we downgrade mid cycle? Just curious how the prorated amount shows on the bill.
My receipt shows a tax line that should not be there. I raised this before and I am a bit fed up with chasing it. Frustrating.
Our finance team closes the quarter tomorrow. We need the corrected invoice and the payment receipt by end of day, it is urgent for the audit.
Your billing is a joke. I was overcharged for six months and nobody noticed. Pathetic, useless support. I want a manager to call me.
Please add our PO reference to future invoices. Thanks so much, the billing portal is great otherwise.
I need the refund for the duplicate payment today. I have asked twice already and I am not happy about the delay, it is getting old. Please treat it as urgent.
Is it possible to pay by bank transfer instead of card? We are a school, and we would need an invoice for each term.
The desktop app shows a sync error on one folder since the latest version. Everything else works. Logs attached for when you have time.
The sync service is down AGAIN and my whole team is locked out. This outage is a nightmare, we are losing money every hour. FIX IT NOW!!!
Uploads of large video files keep failing with a timeout. It is frustrating, this is the third time I have reported it.
Production backups stopped working last night and we have an audit coming. Please look at this urgently, we are blocked.
Small bug: the mobile app shows the wrong folder icon after a rename. Not urgent, just letting you know.
I am sick of this. Every update breaks the sync, the app crashes, and your support answers are useless. Worst backup tool I have paid for. We are switching to another provider.
How do I restore a deleted file from version history? I could not find it in the web app.
The API returns error 500 on every upload since this morning. Our release is blocked and the deadline is Friday. Disappointing, and frankly not impressed with the silence on your status page.
The Windows app freezes for a few seconds when I open a big shared drive. Here is the error code: FS-2291.
We lost files!!! The sync corrupted a whole project folder and the client presentation is in two hours. This is an emergency. Absolutely unacceptable.
Is there a known glitch with the Linux client? It reinstalled itself after the last update and the sync starts from zero each time.
Sync has been crashing on my laptop for a week. I reinstalled twice. Honestly a bit let down, I expected better, and this is tiresome.
Our office cannot work: the shared drive went down ten minutes ago for all 40 users. Please treat this as critical.
Logs attached. The upload of my photo library stops at 80 percent with a timeout error. Any idea?
Third crash this week. Your desktop app is garbage and the last update made it worse. Ridiculous for a paid product.
Could you check why conflict copies keep appearing in our design folder? It happens when two people save at the same time. It would be great if the app warned us.
We are evaluating tools like yours for a 120 person agency. Could we get a demo and a quote for the team plan?
Our procurement deadline is Friday. Please send pricing for 300 seats as soon as you can, the purchase has to be signed this week.
Do you have a discount for nonprofit organisations? We would need about 15 licenses.
I am on the free plan and thinking about upgrading. How much is Pro per user if I pay yearly?
We are a reseller in Portugal and would like to talk about a partnership. Who on your sales team should I contact? No hurry.
We want to buy 50 more seats today. Our new hires start tomorrow morning, so please send the quote right away.
I asked for a demo twice through your website and nobody replied. Disappointing, and a frustrating way to treat someone who wants to buy.
Can you share the price list for the enterprise plan? We are also looking at other providers for next year.
Our trial ends soon and we would like a proof of concept with single sign-on before we commit. Who can help with the rollout?
Is there volume pricing above 500 seats? Our procurement team would like a formal quote.
I have been trying to upgrade for a week and your sales team keeps ignoring me. Incompetent. How dare you leave a paying customer hanging. I want to speak to a manager.
We love the product. Could someone walk our leads through a demo of the team plan next month?
I need the quote for our annual plan by tomorrow. This is the second time I am asking and it is getting annoying. We sign this week.
Thanks so much for the quick reply earlier. That said, being charged twice and then having sync break the same day is unacceptable.
No rush at all, but our production backups have been failing since Monday.
We might upgrade to the team plan, but first I need to know why the last invoice shows a charge for seats we never added.
Love the product, honestly. But the mobile app crashed again during a client demo and it was a bit disappointing.
Is the outage fixed? Whenever you get a moment, could you also tell me how much the enterprise plan costs?
I want a refund. Actually, if you can fix the upload error today I will stay and even add seats.
Your pricing page says one thing and my bill says another. Which is right? Not urgent, but it is getting old.
URGENT?? Not really, just kidding. When you get a chance, can you look at why my folder icons look odd.
The shared drive is down for one intern, everyone else is fine. Take your time.
Great service overall, five stars. One thing though: the renewal charge was higher than the quote your sales rep gave us.
I am not angry, just confused: the app says payment failed, but my bank shows the charge went through and now sync is paused.
Before we sign for 200 seats, legal needs to know if the outage last month caused any data loss. Deadline is Friday, but do not drop everything.
Third time asking nicely: please cancel the add-on and refund the difference. Cheers.
The new pricing is ridiculous, although to be fair the product itself has been flawless and support was kind.
Can someone call me right now about upgrading? Actually tomorrow is fine too, whenever works.
Invoice attached. Also the desktop app asks me to log in every hour, and I would like a quote for ten more seats. Thanks!
